Examine the PDF file at /root/sc100-blank.pdf to list all fillable form fields. Use Python with a PDF library to extract field names, types, and any default values. Try using pypdf or pdfrw or pikepdf - install whatever is needed. Run:

```
pip install pypdf pikepdf 2>/dev/null
python3 -c "
from pypdf import PdfReader
reader = PdfReader('/root/sc100-blank.pdf')
fields = reader.get_fields()
if fields:
    for name, field in fields.items():
        print(f'Field: {name}')
        print(f'  Type: {field.get(\"/FT\", \"unknown\")}')
        print(f'  Value: {field.get(\"/V\", \"\")}')
        print(f'  Options: {field.get(\"/Opt\", \"\")}')
        print()
else:
    print('No fields found via get_fields')
    # Try alternative approach
    for page_num, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
        if '/Annots' in page:
            for annot in page['/Annots']:
                obj = annot.get_object()
                if obj.get('/FT'):
                    print(f'Page {page_num}: {obj.get(\"/T\", \"unnamed\")} - Type: {obj.get(\"/FT\")} - Value: {obj.get(\"/V\", \"\")}')
"
```

If that doesn't work well, try pikepdf:
```
python3 -c "
import pikepdf
pdf = pikepdf.open('/root/sc100-blank.pdf')
for page_num, page in enumerate(pdf.pages):
    if '/Annots' in page:
        for annot in page['/Annots']:
            annot_obj = annot.resolve() if hasattr(annot, 'resolve') else pdf.get_object(annot)
            ft = annot_obj.get('/FT', '')
            t = annot_obj.get('/T', '')
            v = annot_obj.get('/V', '')
            print(f'Page {page_num}: Name={t}, Type={ft}, Value={v}')
"
```

Print ALL field names completely - do not truncate or summarize.
